body: Egocentric video understanding spans diverse capabilities, modalities, and evaluation formats, yet these are often studied in isolation despite their tight coupling in real-world interaction. We propose the Ego-Action-World interaction loop as a unifying principle: the wearer perceives the world, forms goals, acts, changes the world, and uses feedback to guide subsequent behavior. Based on this view, we introduce EgoOmniWorld, a benchmark organized around four complementary interaction structures: Node captures ego, action, and world states; Edge captures directed relations among them; Chain captures linked dependencies; and Loop captures feedback-closed interactions. We develop an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data pipeline that extracts structured interactions from egocentric videos, grounds them in visual and auditory evidence, and generates questions according to their interaction structure. Required modalities and single- or multi-turn formats follow naturally from the supporting evidence and dependencies. EgoOmniWorld contains 24,166 QA groups, including 20,284 training and 3,882 test samples. Experiments on representative open- and closed-source multimodal large language models reveal substantial and uneven limitations across interaction structures. Models trained on EgoOmniWorld improve in-domain interaction understanding and generalize to existing egocentric benchmarks. EgoOmniWorld provides a unified foundation for evaluating and advancing egocentric video understanding. Data, code, and models will be released.
summaryZh: 本文提出了EgoOmniWorld基准测试，旨在统一评估多模态大模型在自我中心视频中的交互理解能力。研究基于“感知-目标-行动-反馈”的交互循环，构建了包含节点、边、链、循环四种结构的评估体系。通过对24,166个QA样本的测试，揭示了当前模型在处理复杂交互时的局限性。该基准为推动多模态模型在真实世界交互场景下的泛化能力提供了重要工具，并公开了相关数据与代码。

glossary.explanationZh: 自我中心视频，指从第一人称视角拍摄的视频数据。
交互循环，指感知、行动与反馈构成的闭环交互过程。
多模态大语言模型，指能够处理文本、图像、视频等多种模态数据的模型。
证据驱动，指模型输出需基于视频中的视觉或听觉证据。
